title_en: August 2026 Master's and Doctoral Completion and Graduation Candidate Lists
summary: Graduate students who expect to complete coursework (수료) or receive a degree in August 2026 must check the attached candidate lists and their own requirements, and report any discrepancy to the department office (Building 301, Room 319): degree candidates by 22 July 2026; completion candidates, including those wishing to defer completion, by 23 July 2026. Students contacted by telephone must submit a Non-Completion Confirmation by 23 July 2026, and anyone wishing to change their English name on the diploma must apply on MySNU by 23 July 2026. Expected doctoral degree recipients must complete the Ministry of Education survey and email the completion certificate to the staff member in charge by 7 August 2026.
applies_to: Graduate students (master's, doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral programs) who expect to complete coursework or receive a degree in August 2026. Completion candidates are master's and doctoral students who have registered for 4 or more semesters, and integrated master's-doctoral students who have registered for 6 or more semesters, and who have earned the credits required for completion; completion is assessed automatically, without an application. The Non-Completion Confirmation is required only from students the office contacts by telephone. The Ministry of Education survey applies only to expected doctoral degree recipients and is mandatory for them. The English name change is only for those who wish to change their name.

conditions: There is no application for completion; eligible students are assessed automatically, so anyone who believes they complete this semester must check that their name is on the list.
If no contact is made by the deadline, the list is treated as correct and processing proceeds.
The lists may change: names may be removed or added depending on the department office's review of completion and graduation requirements.
Students who have not submitted the approval request for courses taken in other departments (or undergraduate courses) must submit it now.
Students who submit a Non-Completion Confirmation or a Completion Deferral Request become students exceeding the regular semesters and must register next semester.
Students exceeding the regular semesters pay half tuition for 3 credits or fewer and full tuition for 4 credits or more.
Students exceeding the regular semesters who cancel course registration down to 0 credits will be expelled for non-registration.
Students exceeding the regular semesters are master's and doctoral students from their 5th semester and integrated master's-doctoral students from their 9th semester.
Students who neither register for courses nor take a leave of absence will be expelled.
Students on a leave of absence cannot graduate or complete.
Integrated master's-doctoral students pay full tuition up to their 8th semester.
Research student registration (fee of 200,000 won) is mandatory in the semester in which a thesis review is requested.

Completion requires: master's 4–8 registrations and at least 24 credits including at least 9 credits of School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) graduate courses; doctoral 4–12 registrations and at least 36 credits including at least 12 such credits; integrated 6–16 registrations and at least 60 credits including at least 21 such credits (module seminars included).
Students admitted from 2022 must complete one research ethics course; at most 3 credits are recognised.
Both the overall GPA and the major-course GPA must each be at least 3.0 on a 4.3 scale.
The Ministry of Education survey is mandatory, not optional, for expected doctoral degree recipients.
Diplomas cannot be reissued, so the Korean and English names printed on them must be correct.
A copy of a passport or alien registration card can be attached to an English name change application.
steps: All students: Check your completion or graduation requirements in the academic guidebook given at admission and the self-check checklist under the academic board's FAQ (학사게시판 - 자주 묻는 질문).
All students: Check the attached list of completion and degree candidates (수료 및 학위수여 예정자) for your name; note that this list was not among the attachments provided with the text and was not read.
All students: If you have taken courses in other departments (or undergraduate courses) without submitting the approval request (타학과(또는 학부과목) 이수 승인 신청서), submit it now.

All students: If anything is irregular (on the list but wish to defer, eligible but not listed, listed but not meeting requirements, or a degree candidate not listed), tell the staff member in charge at the department office, Building 301, Room 319; contact details are in the original notice.
Completion candidates: If the office contacts you by telephone, submit the Non-Completion Confirmation (attachment 1, 미수료확인서 서식) by 23 July 2026.
Completion candidates: If you do not wish to complete this semester, submit the Completion Deferral Request (attachment 2, 수료유예원 서식) by 23 July 2026.
Completion candidates: If you submit either form, register next semester and do not cancel down to 0 credits.
Degree candidates: If the degree candidate list is wrong, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319) by 22 July 2026.

Degree candidates: Check your English name on the MySNU login screen; to change it, read the attached guide on English name changes (not provided with the text and not read) and apply by 23 July 2026 via MySNU → Academic Information System (학사정보시스템) → Change of Academic Status (학적변동) → Apply (신청) → Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부기재사항정정), attaching a copy of your passport or alien registration card.

Doctoral degree candidates: Read the survey manual (attachment 4-1 Korean or 4-2 English), take part in the Ministry of Education survey, and email the survey completion certificate to the staff member in charge by 7 August 2026 (email address in the original notice).
Degree candidates: From the afternoon of the degree conferment ceremony, issue your degree certificate on MySNU if needed.
translation:
[Graduate School] ★ Lists of Expected Master's and Doctoral Completion/Graduation Candidates for August 2026

※ You must check whether you meet the requirements for completion/graduation by reviewing the academic guidebook distributed at admission and the checklist in the post on the academic board under Frequently Asked Questions.

1. Expected completion candidates

A. There is no separate application for completion. Master's and doctoral students who have registered for 4 or more semesters and earned the credits required for completion, and integrated master's-doctoral students who have registered for 6 or more semesters and earned the credits required for completion, are subject to the completion assessment. Therefore, if you believe this is your completion semester, you must check that your name is on the list.

B. Non-Completion Confirmation (미수료 확인서): students required to submit it will be notified by telephone; they must submit the Non-Completion Confirmation (see attachment) by Thursday, 23 July 2026.

C. List of expected completion candidates: see the attachment (Completion and Degree Conferment Candidates, 수료 및 학위수여 예정자). [Note: this list was not among the attachments provided and was not read.]

※ If you are on the completion candidate list but do not wish to complete this semester, please submit the Completion Deferral Request (수료유예원, see attachment) by Thursday, 23 July 2026. If there is no contact by the deadline, it will be treated as correct and processing will proceed.

★ (Must read) Important! ★
1. The list of completion/graduation candidates has been posted as attached, but please note that names may be removed from or added to the list, and other changes may occur, depending on the department office's review of completion/graduation requirements.
※ Final review is in progress, including whether the approval request for courses in other departments (or undergraduate courses) has been submitted and whether completion requirements are met.
Therefore, students must also check the academic guidebook and the completion self-check checklist on the academic board under Frequently Asked Questions.
2. If you have taken courses in other departments (or undergraduate courses) and have not submitted the approval request (타학과(또는 학부과목) 이수 승인 신청서), you must submit it now.
3. Anyone with a special situation — for example, you are on this semester's completion list but wish to defer completion; you believe you are eligible for completion but are not on the list; you believe you do not meet completion requirements but are on the list; or you are a graduation candidate but are not on the list — must tell the staff member in charge (contact details are in the original notice).

D. Notes for non-completing/completing students
If you submit the Non-Completion Confirmation or the Completion Deferral Request, you become a student exceeding the regular semesters and must register next semester (3 credits or fewer: pay half of tuition; 4 credits or more: pay full tuition). Please note that a student exceeding the regular semesters who cancels course registration and ends up with 0 credits will be expelled for non-registration.
Students exceeding the regular semesters: (enrolled students) master's and doctoral from the 5th semester; (enrolled students) integrated master's-doctoral from the 9th semester.
※ If you neither register for courses nor take a leave of absence, you will be expelled.
You cannot graduate or complete while on a leave of absence.
Integrated master's-doctoral students pay full tuition up to the 8th semester.

D. Reference: thesis submission deadline — within 4 years after master's completion; within 6 years after doctoral completion.
※ You may graduate after passing the thesis review within the thesis submission deadline; research student registration (fee of 200,000 won) is mandatory in the semester in which you apply for the thesis review.

Category | Master's | Doctoral | Integrated Master's-Doctoral
Number of registrations | 4–8 | 4–12 | 6–16
Minimum credits | 24 or more | 36 or more | 60 or more
 | At least 9 credits of School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) graduate courses (including module seminars) | At least 12 credits of School of Electrical and Computer Engineering graduate courses (including module seminars) | At least 21 credits of School of Electrical and Computer Engineering graduate courses (including module seminars)
From 2022 admission | Research ethics course: one course must be completed (only up to 3 credits recognised). * Related notice: link (not read)
Grades | Overall GPA and major-course GPA each 3.0 or higher (on a 4.3 scale)

2. Expected degree recipients

A. List of expected degree recipients: see the attachment (Completion and Degree Conferment Candidates). [Not provided with the text and not read.]
※ If you find an error in the list, contact the department office by Wednesday, 22 July 2026. If there is no contact by the deadline, it will be treated as correct and processing will proceed.

B. Ministry of Education statistical survey: participate in the survey following the manual in Attachment 4, then submit the survey completion certificate to the staff member in charge by email by Friday, 7 August 2026 (email address in the original notice).
※ Applies only to expected doctoral degree recipients; participation is mandatory, not optional.

C. Checking and changing your English name
Your English name (viewable on your MySNU login screen) will be printed on your diploma at graduation. Referring to the attachment (Guide to Changing the English Name in Student Records — not provided with the text and not read), those who wish to change their English name should apply by Thursday, 23 July 2026.
※ How to apply (enrolled students, students who have completed, and graduates alike): MySNU → Academic Information System (학사정보시스템) → Change of Academic Status (학적변동) → Apply (신청) → Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부기재사항정정)
※ You can apply for an English name change by attaching a copy of your passport or alien registration card.
※ The Korean and English names are printed on the diploma (degree certificate), and diplomas cannot be reissued.

3. Reference
- Certificates of completion and degree conferment certificates can be issued (MySNU) from the afternoon of the degree conferment ceremony.

4. Contact
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319); staff member in charge and email address are given in the original notice.
